source_quality.notes: All 29 pages were extracted. Five pages have an empty text layer and were opened as proxies. Formula crops were taken from the 120 dpi rasters. Later caption-only figures stay on the text layer.

task_reconstruction.summary: Forecast 2028 medal counts and intervals, split into a host, past medalists, and countries without medals.
Estimate which never-medaled countries win a first medal, with the agreement slip kept.
Score a great coach and name three programs that should hire one.
Relate medals to economic strength, stated once as per capita and later as log(GDP).

section_map.summary: Summary of three tasks, a while-hedge, and a keyword line.
A spectacle, two small countries, and the factors existing models miss.
Notation under the heading Assumputions, with weighed and none-medal.
Four assumptions and a K-means split into six classes.
A 0.5 cutoff, a floor at zero, and a Monte Carlo bracket.
ARIMA(0,0,2) after an AIC heatmap, then a forest interval.
A Fisher score whose printed alpha is two unequal ratios.
Sensitivity of the interval and of the cutoff r.
Strengths, weaknesses, and references including Unknown Author.
An AI report that names ChatGPT-4o with a 2023 date.

contributions.summary: The United States combined line is 54.57 gold, 52.16 silver, 32.37 bronze, totaling 139.
First medals are forecast as 3.09, with interval [2.58, 4.87].
Three programs are named, and Lang Ping's contributions are given as 0.75 and 0.5 points.

dependency_graph.summary: The new-event expectation is added after the host boost.
The Poisson share uses the ARIMA count and the disintegrated count.
The coach score uses the same medal colors the forecast just rounded.

assumptions.summary: Politics and doping do not affect participation, and every team is complete.
Five named sports are added as ten knockout events, and four named sports are removed.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: About 70 events are grouped because analyzing all of them is called not practical.
K-means uses K = 6, the elbow, literature insights, and a manual correction.
New events take current rankings. Discontinued events are dropped.

models.summary: A correlation cutoff chooses an average or a floored six-point line, then a Monte Carlo or a ranking logistic.
A host boost is one ratio minus one, in percent.
ARIMA(0,0,2) plus a forest interval, then a Poisson share for one country.
Class similarity is a normalized squared distance of medal shares.
A coach is scored by medal points and a printed ratio called alpha.

verification.summary: ADF is -4.01 with p-value 0.0014. Residual checks are reported as p greater than 0.05.
Raising the confidence widens the interval and does not move the point.
The United States point stays 139 and 55 while r runs from 0.3 to 0.7.

results_trace.summary: Traditional-event medals 53.64, 51.43, 31.56, 136.63, then the combined line totaling 139.
Bangladesh and Nicaragua are the two new-event first-medal chances. The ranking year is printed as 2024.
log(GDP) correlates with total medals at about 0.83, and ten events are named as even.

writing_logic.summary: Each task block names a method, then a result, and the sheet closes on a while-hedge.
Each assumption is announced as followed by its explanation.
A branch is two If sentences before the case brace.

language_observations.summary: Three groups is followed by four names, and Chinas, Indias, Brazils drop the apostrophe.
The heading is Assumputions, the increment is weighed, and the country is none-medal.
most likely(95%confidence) has no spaces, and less medals is higher.

visualization_observations.summary: Figure 1 is captioned Our work. The text layer is a block of the letter m. The raster was not opened.
Figure 2 is Sports Distribution Classification (K-means), six labeled clusters.
Figure 3 is a 16-athlete knockout bracket captioned Monte Carlo Method for Simulating New Events.
Table 2 lists host new-event medals from 1984 through 2024.
Table 3 lists host factors. The 2028 average cell prints 115, and the increase is to be predicted.
Figures 4 and 5 are the trend and the ADF check. Text captions only.
Figures 6 through 11 are ACF, PACF, the AIC heatmap, residual checks, and a QQ plot. Text captions only.
Figures 12 and 13 compare the actual series with the forecast and the interval [2.58, 4.87]. Text captions only.
Figure 14 is the exponential regression for disintegrated countries, with a band near [0.00, 0.01].
Figure 15 ranks ten first-medal countries. BAN is the tallest bar. Other bar heights were not read.
Figures 16 and 17 are the top-10 total and gold predictions. The text layer is scrambled and the raster was not opened.
Figures 18 and 19 are uncertainty charts for the top 10 and for countries under 10 medals. Captions only.
Figure 20 is the class heatmap. Green is stronger, red is weaker, and the diagonal is 1.
Table 5 is captioned Table Title and maps medals to points.
Table 6 scores Lang Ping and Bela Karolyi. The raster, not the shifted text layer, is the source.
Table 7 gives China volleyball Top 8 to Top 3, India athletics Top 5 in Asia to Top 8, and Brazil gymnastics Top 20 to Top 10.
Figure 21 is the GDP scatter, with legend r = 0.83 and y = 35.86x + 32.77.
Figures 22 through 26 are captioned at 60, 80, 90, 95, and 99 percent. The page text is only captions.
Tables 8 and 9 give total and gold medals at r from 0.3 to 0.7.
Tables 10 and 11 repeat the same grid under the watermark and are not a second dataset.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: A judge can test whether 53.64, 51.43, and 31.56 sum to 136.63, and whether the combined line sums to 139.
A judge can test whether the two printed alpha ratios are equal.
A judge can test whether the sensitivity gold of 55 is the same quantity as the host-section gold of 54.57.

weaknesses.summary: The three printed medal blocks do not add to the printed totals.
Russia is the exception in the results and a 60/22 forecast in the sensitivity table.
Alpha is two unequal expressions, and Table 5 is captioned Table Title.
Two different United States forecasts both contain the number 139.

independent_extensions.summary: The printed alpha could be compared with a Fisher tail sum computed from the same n, m, and t, without replacing the printed ratio.

unresolved_questions: Table 4 on the first-medal page is column-shifted in the text layer. The crop stops after the header and one partial Nicaragua row, so the remaining probabilities stay unpaired.
Figure 1 was not opened as a raster. The text layer is a block of the letter m.
Figures 4 through 13 and 16 through 19 and 22 through 26 stay on text captions. Their bars and cells were not read.
Tables 10 and 11 repeat Tables 8 and 9 under the watermark and are not transcribed as new numbers.
The 2028 host-average cell prints 115. No boost is computed from it here.
The exponential regression has no displayed equation. The interval [0, 0.01] is not turned into a formula.
Figure 21's line y = 35.86x + 32.77 was read from the legend and is not given a governing equation.
